A big hello to all new users who have recently migrated over from the shitstorm that shall not be namedTM. Just a quick update on what the state of play is with this app for anybody who might not know:

* Voat are about to release a new API for developers which should make life a lot easier * I have focused on adding new features to Vulcan which rely on this beta API * Everytime the beta API looks like it's about to get released, a massive reddit influx seems to occur that delays that work. My current gut feeling is it will be released by the end of July, but only the Voat admins know for sure.

On the plus side, this means that I have had a lot of time to develop new features! Here is a list of some of the functionality I've already added in that isn't present on the Play Store version of Vulcan: - Login - Sorting subverses by hot/new etc - Saving subverses to favorites for quick navigation - Creating, editing, and deleting submissions - Viewing comments for submissions - A bazillion UI/UX improvements

I am currently working on: - Comment folding, so that it should be easy to expand/collapse the children of a comment - Voting on submissions/comments (I've done this really, just waiting on a few changes in the API) - Replying/Editing/Deleting comments (again, I've basically done this, just need to iron out a few tricky bugs) - Fixing bugs/polishing the app so that it's ready for a release

I am currently looking for alpha testers, if you're interested let me know via a PM and I will send you screenshots/a release nearer the time of release. I haven't forgotten about it, it just seems to have been delayed along with everything else! Any questions/comments let me know!

Crosspost from KotakuInAction: IGN - FINAL FANTASY XIV - THE TROUBLE WITH "GATING" aka bitching about having to actually play the game.

Should some content be gated? Yes. Should all of it? No. At this point, there is just an ever increasing ladder of content required to be completed before new players even get to play the game. This may also be an issue of SE being SE and not having any idea of what the fuck they are doing in addition to bloating the game with filler. How long would someone have to play before they can actually play the game? I understand the people want the game to be made for the people who have been playing it, but there is a point where gating certain content becomes absurd.

But A Realm Reborn is the game as well. I understand that new players want to be able to fly and try out the new classes, but I think this is a necessary evil for what they are able to accomplish by using the current system.

Except its not just ARR, its all of the story content updates that have happened since ARR. If it was just ARR, it honestly wouldn't be so bad, but there is around 2 years of content people have to play through just to catch up. Personally, I think the way XI handled it was better.
